trust_decision.summary: Whether a client-supplied request body (which may carry push-notification token/authentication.credentials) may be written to server logs when protobuf JSON parsing fails; decided in each transport's parse helper catch block.

landing_point.why: Summary says 'push notification credentials logged on protobuf parse failure'; the REST handler's createTaskPushNotificationConfiguration (line 386) calls parseRequestBody whose catch logs the raw body at SEVERE.

fix_sites.entry_point: REST RestHandler.createTaskPushNotificationConfiguration (also sendMessage, sendStreamingMessage) via reference/rest A2AServerRoutes
REST v0.3 RestHandler_v0_3.setTaskPushNotificationConfiguration (also sendMessage, sendStreamingMessage) via compat-0.3/reference/rest

O3_reason_to_dismiss: For the published fix: the v0.3 compat module is a legacy protocol shim a solver may skip. For the O8 JSON-RPC route: it logs at Level.FINE (off by default), sits in a spec/utils module rather than a handler, and the report names only SEVERE REST logging.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Parse failures must still be logged (the fix keeps a length-only message and the 'Parse error details' exception log) and still return 422/InvalidParams with a 'Failed to parse request body' message; the JSON-RPC path must still map proto errors to -32602 with the field-name extract. An over-broad fix that removes all logging or changes the error mapping breaks the regression test (which asserts a '(length=' log line) and existing error-code tests.

O6_input_shapes: TaskPushNotificationConfig body with token and authentication.credentials plus an unknown field (fix.diff:1245-1256)
v0.3 CreateTaskPushNotificationConfigRequest body with nested pushNotificationConfig (fix.diff:1131-1143)

SendMessageRequest body reaching the same parseRequestBody (transport/rest/src/main/java/org/a2aproject/sdk/transport/rest/handler/RestHandler.java:242, :309; compat-0.3/transport/rest/src/main/java/org/a2aproject/sdk/compat03/transport/rest/handler/RestHandler_v0_3.java:94, :112); whether it can carry an inline push config is unverified

O8_uncovered_routes.route: JSON-RPC server request parsing logs the raw params JSON (including push-config token/credentials) when protobuf merge fails
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Logged at Level.FINE (debug, off by default), lives in spec-grpc utils, not a transport handler, and the advisory names REST.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: different Maven module and package (spec-grpc org.a2aproject.sdk.grpc.utils) from transport/rest; reached via reference/jsonrpc/src/main/java/org/a2aproject/sdk/server/apps/quarkus/A2AServerRoutes.java:337 -> spec-grpc/src/main/java/org/a2aproject/sdk/grpc/utils/JSONRPCUtils.java:182,227-229,436-437

O8b_injection_room.sibling: the conversion helper could log the offending JSON snippet alongside the request id
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: it already logs debugging context at FINE for every parse failure; adding the body is a typical maintainer debugging aid

O8b_injection_room.sibling: the record's default toString exposes token/credentials; a planted LOGGER.debug("...{}", config) in the request handler or a config store would leak them
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: how-type: the leak comes from the record's generated toString (a serializer-like producer), not the log line; neighbouring stores already log config ids at debug (extras/push-notification-config-store-database-jpa/src/main/java/org/a2aproject/sdk/extras/pushnotificationconfigstore/database/jpa/JpaDatabasePushNotificationConfigStore.java:61)

O8b_injection_room.sibling: the record toString includes credentials, so any exception message built from it would leak
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: validation errors that echo request values are already common in this codebase's InvalidParamsError messages (transport/rest/src/main/java/org/a2aproject/sdk/transport/rest/handler/RestHandler.java:390)

O9_family: CWE-532 sensitive information in log files (secrets in logs)
